title: Landfall LayoutSchema v1.0
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for Landfall layout YAML/JSON files. Defines card positions, visibility, lock state, and per-card-type displayConfig on a Landfall display.

version.description: Schema version. Must be exactly the string "1.0".

name.description: Display name for this layout document. Max 80 characters.

profileSlug.description: If set, the layout is applied to this named profile. Must match an existing profile slug. If omitted, applies to the currently active profile.

grid.description: Grid dimensions. If omitted, the display's current dimensions are preserved. Changing dimensions reflows all cards; cards that overflow are clamped to fit.

cards.description: List of card configuration entries. At least one entry required. Empty arrays are rejected. Each source may appear at most once.

source.description: Source identifier for the card. System sources: system.clock, system.weather.current, system.weather.forecast, system.calendar, system.photos. Feed: agent.feed. Agent-pushed cards use agent.<name> form but cannot be repositioned via LayoutSchema.

visible.description: Card visibility. If omitted, current state is preserved.

locked.description: When true, the card cannot be moved or resized in the drag-and-drop editor. If omitted, current state is preserved.

mood.description: System card mood override. Only meaningful for system cards — agent-pushed cards carry their mood from the push payload. If omitted, current state is preserved.

displayConfig.description: Card-type-specific display configuration. Unknown keys produce a warning but are not rejected. See displayConfig definitions per source type.

slot.description: Grid position and span for the card. If omitted, the card's current slot is preserved.

column.description: Zero-indexed column position. Must be within grid bounds.

row.description: Zero-indexed row position. Must be within grid bounds.

columnSpan.description: Card width in grid columns. column + columnSpan must not exceed the grid column count.

rowSpan.description: Card height in grid rows. row + rowSpan must not exceed the grid row count.

showSeconds.description: Whether to display the seconds digit. Default: false.

showDate.description: Whether to display the date line below the time. Default: true.

showDayOfWeek.description: Whether to include the day of week in the date line. Only meaningful if showDate is true. Default: true.

use24Hour.description: 24-hour clock format. When false, displays AM/PM suffix. Default: false.

variant.description: large = maximum available font size. compact = reduced size, leaving room for additional content. Default: large.

units.description: Temperature and wind speed units. imperial = °F/mph, metric = °C/km/h. Default: imperial.

showFeelsLike.description: Display the feels-like temperature below the actual temperature. Default: true.

showWind.description: Display wind speed and direction. Default: false.

showConditionLabel.description: Display the text condition label (e.g. "Partly Cloudy"). When false, only the icon is shown. Default: true.

variant.description: minimal shows only temperature and condition icon. Default: standard.

units.description: Temperature units. Should match system.weather.current if both are shown. Default: imperial.

days.description: Number of forecast days to display. Cards narrower than 8 columns should use 3. Default: 5.

showHighLow.description: Show daily high and low temperatures per tile. When false, shows only the high. Default: true.

showPrecipitation.description: Show precipitation probability per tile. Default: false.

daysAhead.description: How many days of upcoming events to include. Default: 7.

maxEvents.description: Maximum number of events to show, ordered by start time ascending. Default: 8.

showTime.description: Show event start time. All-day events always show "All day". Default: true.

showCalendarColor.description: Show the calendar feed's color dot next to each event. Default: true.

showLocation.description: Show event location if present. Recommended only for cards with rowSpan >= 3. Default: false.

hideAllDay.description: When true, all-day events are filtered out of the list. Default: false.

variant.description: compact reduces line height and removes the color dot to fit more events. Default: list.

intervalSeconds.description: How long each photo is displayed before transitioning. Default: 30.

transitionDurationMs.description: Transition animation duration in milliseconds. Default: 800.

showCaption.description: Show photo filename or caption if available. Default: false.

fit.description: cover fills the slot (may crop). contain shows the full image (may letterbox). Default: cover.

randomOrder.description: When true, photos cycle in random order. When false, cycles in source folder order. Default: true.

maxCards.description: Maximum number of agent cards in the panel. Null means no cap (profile's maxAgentCards applies). Default: null.

showSource.description: Show the source label below each card's title. Default: true.

showTimestamp.description: Show the card's push timestamp. Default: true.

cardSpacing.description: Vertical spacing between cards in the feed. Default: normal.
